description.p: BMCD (Bye!MinecraftDownloader) fetches Minecraft game files: it reads the piston-meta version manifest, resolves a version's asset index and libraries, and downloads the whole file set in parallel with SHA-1 verification.
The window colours follow the desktop's matugen-generated KDE colour scheme, and update live when the wallpaper changes.
Internal beta: install-chain and packaging validation.
